# Researcher.Life

> Researcher.Life is a comprehensive AI-powered platform providing research tools, literature discovery, academic writing assistance, and publication services for researchers worldwide.

The platform integrates multiple specialized tools including R Discovery for literature search across 250M+ papers, Paperpal for academic writing assistance, Journal Finder for publication targeting, and Mind The Graph for scientific visualization. Researcher.Life also offers training through Upskill courses to support researchers at every stage of their academic journey.

## Key Topics

- R Discovery
- Paperpal
- Journal Finder
- Mind The Graph
- Editage
- AI research tools
- Academic writing
- Literature search
- Paper discovery

## Core Platform

- [Researcher.Life - AI Tools For Research & Expert Publication Services](https://researcher.life): Main platform hub: comprehensive suite of AI research tools and publication services for academics
- [All Access Plans and Pricing](https://researcher.life/all-access-pricing): Subscription plans and pricing for Researcher.Life All Access features

## Literature Discovery & Research

- [R Discovery - AI Academic Research Reading App](https://discovery.researcher.life): AI literature search tool with 250M+ papers, research summaries, and personalized recommendations
- [AI Literature Recommender for Researchers](https://researcher.life/all-access-features/literature-recommender): R Discovery literature recommender: personalized paper recommendations with multi-language translations

## Writing & Publishing Tools

- [Academic Writing Assistant & Paraphraser](https://researcher.life/all-access-features/academic-writing-assistant): Paperpal: AI-powered academic writing assistant with paraphrasing, grammar checking, and citation management
- [AI Journal Finder for Researchers](https://researcher.life/all-access-features/journal-finder): Journal Finder: AI-powered journal recommendations with impact metrics and indexing data

## Research Visualization

- [Scientific Illustration Tool & Infographic Maker](https://researcher.life/all-access-features/scientific-illustration-tool): Mind The Graph: scientific illustration tool for creating professional infographics and visual abstracts

## Learning & Development

- [Upskill - Online Courses For Research Training](https://upskill.researcher.life): Online courses and handbooks for research training, publication strategy, and career development
